bio: I hold a Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering, with a thesis on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for Large Language Models (LLMs).
Today I focus on agentic AI and its orchestration: designing systems where multiple LLM-powered agents plan, use tools, retrieve knowledge and collaborate to solve real-world tasks reliably.
Curious and results-driven, I’m looking to apply my academic background to projects that combine innovation, data-driven insights and meaningful impact.
